Values.// platform_reliability_cron_setting: Hotel and cruise journey sync (SyncHotelJourneys, SyncCruiseJourneys). Never remove it: a missing value fails indexing for every function in the app.
Values.// platform_reliability_database_connect: SQL Server connection string for the durable journey store. Never commit a real value here.
Values.// JourneySync: What the per-vertical sync timers query. Domains is hotels and cruises; each timer syncs only its own vertical.
Values.// Insights:*: Application Insights app ids / tenant ids per domain+environment. See local.config.example.json in the original repo for the shape; never commit real values here.
Values.// Monitoring:*: Latency Spike Monkey thresholds, all optional (nullable = use the documented default: 5000ms / 5 occurrences / 60min window).
Values.// Monitoring:SqlDetectorDomains: CSV of domains that use the SQL-journey-store-based detector instead of KQL (gradual rollout). Empty = every domain still uses KQL.
Values.// Monitoring:ShadowDomains: CSV of domains where the OTHER detector also runs a side-by-side dry run (no Finding created) and logs a comparison - Fase 3 validation. Empty = no shadow comparison.
Values.// Monitoring:SettingsWriteSecret: Shared secret required via X-Settings-Write-Secret on PUT /api/settings/latency/{domain} and PUT /api/settings/llm-client; must match JourneyMonitorApi:SettingsWriteSecret on the Web side. Fails CLOSED - empty does NOT disable the check, it rejects every write. This dev-only value matches docker-compose's default so `func start` (no Docker) can also save settings.
Values.// Monitoring:InternalApiSecret: Shared secret required via X-Internal-Api-Secret on GET /api/findings/{id}/doctor-report and POST /api/settings/llm-client/models; must match JourneyMonitorApi:InternalApiSecret on the Web side. Same fail-closed behavior as SettingsWriteSecret.
Values.// ScoutLatency:* / ScoutException:*: One section per detection agent - the latency scout and the exception scout run the same pipeline over different boards and are tuned apart. All optional. Defaults for both: Enabled=true, WindowHours=4, BucketMinutes=5, TakePerClub=3, Vertical=All, ClubFilter=*, InvestigationMinPriorityRank=3, MaxNewCasesPerRun=25, UseLlmAssessment=true, AllowScoutVeto=false.
Values.// ScoutLatency:Enabled: Set to false to stop that scout's 5-minute cycle without a redeploy. The cycle is still recorded (status 'disabled') so a silenced scout stays visible.
Values.// ScoutLatency:InvestigationMinPriority: Board rank that produces an InvestigationPackage. Stays 3 in EVERY environment, production included - rank 2 yields ~350 candidates per cycle and must not be switched on until the real per-investigation cost has been measured.
Values.// ScoutLatency:WindowHours: How far back the board query looks. 4 matches the Azure workbook; 0.25 (15 min) is the cheaper alternative - each query scans the window across three App Insights resources and takes ~40s.
Values.// Ai:GitHubToken: GitHub OAuth token for the Doctor Monkey's LLM calls via the GitHub Copilot API. MUST start with 'gho_' (a ghp_ PAT is rejected by the chat endpoint). Generate with: gh auth login --scopes copilot && gh auth token. Never commit a real value here.
Values.// Foundry: Microsoft Foundry, the other LLM provider. Fallback only - the Settings tab stores these in SQL and also chooses which provider each agent uses. Endpoint accepts https://<resource>.openai.azure.com with or without the /openai/v1 route.
Values.// Foundry:AuthMode: 'api-key' or 'managed-identity'. Prefer managed-identity: no secret is stored anywhere and the identity needs an inference role on the resource (scope https://ai.azure.com/.default).
Values.// Foundry:ChatDeployment: A DEPLOYMENT name, not a model id - the two are different namespaces. Same for Inspector:DebateModels / Inspector:PlannerModel while the Inspector is on Foundry.
Values.// Rca: RCA Agent. All optional - it composes on demand only, so an unset section is a working default, not a disabled agent. Defaults: Enabled=true, MaxPrecedents=5, MaxTokens=4000.
Values.// Rca:MaxTokens: Output ceiling for the whole document. Do not lower below ~3000: the template is eight sections plus a five-rung Whys chain, and a truncated RCA is unparseable.
Values.// KnowledgeImport:CorpusPath: Directory of converted Markdown the knowledge base imports from. Defaults to /corpus, which docker-compose mounts from docs/RCAS-md. A DEPLOYED environment has no such mount, so POST /api/knowledge/import answers 409 with the path it looked at - the knowledge base simply stays empty and the RCA Agent composes with no precedents. Point this at a mounted volume to change that.
Values.// KnowledgeImport:MaxDocumentsPerRun: Default 500. Importing is the only operation here that makes thousands of embedding calls in a row, so it is capped and never runs on a timer.
